channel.title: dead1nfluence — Julian B.
channel.description: Security research by Julian B. (dead1nfluence): IoT and hardware hacking, BLE exploits, vulnerability research, and LLM security.

item.title: Let Him Cook! Hacking the Meatmeet BBQ Probe | dead1nfluence
item.description: Three-part series reverse engineering the Meatmeet BBQ probe and Android app: ESP32 flash dump, hardcoded credentials, open storage bucket, and a BLE BBQ probe botnet.

item.title: Don't Mind(sDB) me: RCE on MindsDB (CVE-2025-61468) | dead1nfluence
item.description: How combining a path traversal with an arbitrary file upload led to remote code execution (RCE) on the MindsDB AI analytics engine. CVE-2025-61468 and CVE-2025-61469.

item.title: Unauthenticated User Creation in SpamTitan (CVE-2024-45438) | dead1nfluence
item.description: A missing authorization vulnerability in SpamTitan allowing unauthenticated user creation (CVE-2024-45438), discovered with Philippe Caturegli of Seralys.

item.title: Stealing Your Chats In 2 Clicks — Phishing With Grok | dead1nfluence
item.description: How a built-in Grok feature can be abused with clickable links and hidden ASCII smuggling characters to phish users and exfiltrate their chat memory in two clicks.

item.title: I Scraped Every Public LLM Chat So You Didn't Have To | dead1nfluence
item.description: I scraped and grepped every public LLM shared chat link (Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, and more), found leaked secrets and API keys, and documented what was exposed.

item.title: Agent Zero Security Research — CSRF File Upload to RCE | dead1nfluence
item.description: Security research on the Agent Zero open-source project: two CSRF file upload vulnerabilities leading to remote code execution. CVE-2025-55881 and CVE-2025-55882.

item.title: Hacking Furbo: A Pet Project — IoT Security Research | dead1nfluence
item.description: Six-part series reverse engineering the Furbo 360 and Furbo Mini pet cameras and mobile app, uncovering nearly two dozen vulnerabilities across hardware, P2P, and BLE.

item.title: Review: Andrew Bellini's IoT & Hardware Hacking Course (TCM) | dead1nfluence
item.description: A review of Andrew Bellini's 'Beginner's Guide to IoT and Hardware Hacking' course on TCM Security, covering electronics fundamentals through practical hardware hacking.

item.title: Basic Hardware & IoT Hacking Purchase Guide (Canadian Sources) | dead1nfluence
item.description: A basic hardware and IoT hacking purchase guide for budget setups, with sources compiled for Canadian researchers.
